labels.name: Code Review
labels.description: Running or acting on a code review pass, e.g. "Run code review on PR", "Fix code review findings", "Code review at medium effort with inline comments".

labels.name: Bug Fix
labels.description: Diagnosing and correcting a specific reported defect, e.g. "Fix is_hidden flag materialization bug", "Fix bulk selection bug where cmd-click doesn't trigger overlay", "Investigate and fix cold first launch onboarding race condition".

labels.name: Planning & Design Docs
labels.description: Creating or refining a spec/plan document ahead of implementation, e.g. "Create SCHEMA_DOC.md", "Write BULK_MODE.md with design decisions", "Create MCP_PLAN.md", "Add checklist to PLAN.md".

labels.name: Feature Implementation
labels.description: Building new functionality from a plan or checklist, e.g. "Implement user group movement feature", "Implement bulk session selection checklist", "Add search functionality to /sessions page", "Implement REST API routes for group management".

labels.name: Git/PR Workflow
labels.description: Mechanical repo hygiene such as committing, pushing, and managing pull requests, e.g. "Commit the changes", "Create pull request", "Update PR description to reflect actual changes", "Squash commits and update PR description".

labels.name: GitHub Issue Management
labels.description: Reading, creating, or refining GitHub issues, e.g. "Create GitHub issue for user group functionalities", "Read GitHub issue #235 and create CLEANUP_PLAN.md", "Improve GitHub issue #247 title and description with problem/solution breakdown".

tasks.description: Run code review on PR #142 and leave inline comments

Investigate and fix cold first launch onboarding race condition

tasks.note: Overlap stress case: a fix that only exists because of a review pass. Exercises whether the classifier fixates on the review trigger or the actual work (fixing).

tasks.description: Create a pull request that closes issue #90
tasks.note: Overlap stress case: mentions an issue number but the task itself is PR mechanics, not issue authoring/triage.

tasks.description: Read GitHub issue #235 and create CLEANUP_PLAN.md
tasks.note: Overlap stress case: issue-driven but produces a plan doc. Useful to see whether the classifier fires on the issue trigger, the doc output, or both.

tasks.description: Refill the office coffee machine and reboot the router
tasks.note: True negative: should not match any of the six labels. Sanity check that the classifier can say no to everything rather than defaulting to a match.
